svg.title: The same shipment task, four kinds of software
svg.desc: Nested AI families beside four approaches to one task. Deep learning is one family of ML; most foundation models are deep learning models.

g.text: THE SAME SHIPMENT TASK, FOUR KINDS OF SOFTWARE
AGENTIC AI: a model that chooses actions
The logic is known; no prediction is needed.
A focused prediction from structured inputs.
New content; check wording and facts.
Request → lookup, tool call, proposed reschedule
It can act, so it needs permissions and approval.
Deep learning is one family of ML; most foundation models are deep learning models.
